title: Fix general-audience sanitizer Harvey/DM/Patton collateral on academic citations
description: Recurring collateral damage: feed-publisher general-audience sanitizer bans "Harvey" / "Diebold-Mariano" / "Patton" terms but these are unavoidable in academic citation (e.g. "Harvey, Liu and Zhu (2016)"). Two confirmed cases: mile_4c1045ea (K663) had "Harvey" -> "Erb 與合著者" wrong author swap; mile_0c1f9687 had "Harvey" -> "嚴格統計" producing duplicate "嚴格統計, 嚴格統計, Liu and Zhu". Per CLAUDE.md "永遠修流程": (a) introduce citation-context exemption (when string matches `[A-Z][a-z]+,? [A-Z][a-z]+ and ...` or `<author> et al. (yyyy)` pattern, skip sanitizer); OR (b) build whitelist for known author names + key academic terms; OR (c) make sanitizer aware of citation blocks (e.g. `> ` blockquote citations bypass). Option (a) is cleanest. Implement in scripts/feed_sanitizer or wherever the sanitizer regex lives + add 5 regression tests covering Harvey/Liu/Zhu/DM/Patton/Bollerslev citation forms.
findings: Citation-context exemption landed. publish_draft.py + publisher.py symmetrically patched (Option A regex stash/restore). 5 citation patterns (3-author/et-al/2-author/single/comma-year), ASCII+fullwidth bracket support, year-suffix variant. 25 new tests + 22/23 existing PASS (1 unrelated pre-existing fail). error_log.md +4 lessons. Future articles cite Harvey-Liu-Zhu / Patton / Bollerslev cleanly without sanitizer mangling.

title: Paper review (Codex 24h-rule): LASSO 救得了波動率預測嗎？10 個因子全選了，還是輸給古老的 GARCH（K986）
description: Per .claude/rules/agent-delegation.md 2026-05-02 K1018 lesson, production article mile_912dd699 needs Codex source-code-level review within 24h of publish. Pipe article through codex exec --skip-git-repo-check with prompt requesting: (1) verify K986 numbers byte-for-byte against experiments/k986/k986_adaptive_har_results.json (QLIKE GJR=-8.527 vs HAR-3=-8.194; OOS R² 0.4653 vs 0.1895; DM=-7.24); (2) check QLIKE sign convention (lower=better) used consistently; (3) audit any overclaims about LASSO failure (must say regularization detected VIX² correctly, only model-level loss); (4) lookahead check (shift(1) on all 10 factors per script).
findings: Codex primary-path review (codex 0.121.0) — 5 points: 3 PASS + 1 MINOR + 1 MAJOR. (1) PASS numbers byte-aligned (QLIKE -8.527/-8.194/-7.453/-2.670/+2.301/+2.302/+2.447, OOS R²s, n_oos=1824, n_factors=10). (2) PASS QLIKE sign correct, avoided results.json `improvement_pct=-4.07` 語義 trap. (3) MINOR § 4 narrative over-packaging — 「呼應先前多次日頻 GARCH ceiling」太滿；K973 同 daily r² target 但 HAR > GJR — 應寫「另一個 daily noisy-proxy 下 GJR 強勢的案例」. (4) PASS VIX² 8/8 rolling 100% selection byte-aligned. (5) MAJOR shift(1) lookahead claim 太滿。10 factors feature-level lag 都做對，rolling refit 邊界也無 OOS lookahead，但 LassoCV(cv=5) / ElasticNetCV(cv=5) / KFold(shuffle=False) Ridge 都用 plain 5-fold CV → 訓練窗內較晚資料參與較早 fold alpha 選擇 = within-window CV leakage. 應改：「feature-level lag 1 期；但 hyperparameter 選擇用 5-fold CV 而非 TimeSeriesSplit」。Verdict: 主結論 (adaptive HAR no improvement, GJR wins, VIX² consistently selected) source-code 站得住，但需 errata v2 修 2 點 (narrative softening + CV-leakage caveat). 3-model review pattern (Claude → Gemini → Codex) 又一次 surface真問題.

title: K982 post-publish Codex review (24h-rule): mile_9ed87beb sector dispersion + correlation regime
description: Run Codex review on mile_9ed87beb (K982 general-audience article). Check: (1) numerical accuracy vs k982_dispersion_results.json, (2) VIX-sufficiency framing balance (positive=null=success vs negative=no improvement), (3) descriptive vs predictive distinction (regime t=13.7 IS real but VIX subsumes it), (4) shift(1) lookahead claim correctness, (5) source-code-level checks Gemini cannot do.
findings: Codex primary-path review 5 points: 1 PASS + 2 MAJOR + 2 MINOR. (1) MAJOR sample size mismatch: 文章 n=1936 / 2018-06-20 start, results.json effective n_observations=1913 / IS_period 2018-07-24 (rolling 22d + rv_future shift(-22) + predictor shift(1) 縮 sample). (2) MAJOR high-corr t=13.7 是 stats.ttest_ind(rv_future_high, rv_future_low) two-sample mean test, 不是 descriptive 也不是 incremental predictive; 而且 22-day overlapping rv_future 有自相關沒做 HAC/block bootstrap 修正 → t-stat 有 overstated 風險, "PASS Harvey 3.0" claim 太強. (3) PASS DM 4 augmented model framing 平衡 (M2/M3/M4 p>0.12). (4) MINOR strategy backtest 是 gross-of-cost, 文章沒明標 (JSON limitations 有寫). (5) MINOR regime classification 用同日 avg_corr (非 lagged) — 這對 forward sort 是 OK 因 same-day observable, 但文章 "全 shift(1)" 覆蓋過寬. Verdict: 主結論 (VIX-sufficiency confirmation) source-code 站得住, 但需 errata v2 修 4 點 (sample size + regime framing + cost caveat + lookahead 細化).

title: [platform_ops] cron_review.py: weekday-restricted cron 用 croniter 算 expected last fire，不用 fixed max_gap_h（false alarm fix）
description:
Issue: scripts/cron_review.py JOBS dict 用 fixed max_gap_h (collect_us=30, daily_update=30) 判 stale，但這些 cron 設計就限制 weekday range (collect_us='3 7 * * 2-6' = Tue-Sat, daily_update='3 8 * * 1-6' = Mon-Sat)。週日 / 週一遇到 collect_us=30h gap 就 false alarm 寄 boss_report '⚠️ >30h' 給用戶。

2026-05-25 22:00 boss_report 即此 false alarm — 用戶 21:04 回信問「要先處理嗎」。實際 collect_us 健康（週日 5/24 + 週一 5/25 本就不在 cron 範圍）。

Fix:
1. JOBS dict 改帶 cron expression（直接讀 config/runtime_schedules.json）
2. 用 croniter.get_prev() 計算 'expected last fire'（依 cron schedule，週日週一自動 skip）
3. staleness = now - max(expected_last_fire, log_last_end)；超過 1.5 * cron interval 才 flag
4. Regression test: 餵 2026-05-25 22:00 + collect_us cron='3 7 * * 2-6' + log_last=2026-05-23 08:00 → 應判 healthy（next expected = 2026-05-26 07:03 Tue）

Mission alignment: 平台運營 (#4) — monitor 不該 cry wolf，每天 noise email 會降低用戶警覺敏感度（→ 真 incident 也被忽略）。

Provenance: hourly-22 dispatch 2026-05-25 22:09 diagnose K-? incident，email-11761-7800a4 已 close。
result: Made cron_review.py schedule-aware by reading config/runtime_schedules.json and computing previous expected fire via croniter instead of fixed max_gap_h for weekday-only jobs. Added 3 regression tests covering the 2026-05-25 collect_us weekend false-alarm case; tests passed.

title: K1419: Probabilistic RV Quantile Forecasting — HAR/GARCH 點預測 → 條件分位數
description:
Source: arXiv:2508.15922 (Probabilistic RV Quantile Forecasting). Listed unchecked in research_program.md ML-GARCH section. Goal: extend HAR-RV / GJR-GARCH point forecasts to conditional quantile forecasts via quantile regression on residuals, evaluate via Patton (2011) proxy-robust QS / Fissler-Ziegel joint VaR/ES scores against canonical GJR baseline.

Method:
1. Refit HAR-RV (Corsi 2009) + GJR-GARCH(1,1) on SPY 2012-01-03 → 2022-12-31 (IS), OOS 2023-01-01 → today (rolling, expanding-window, signal.shift(1)).
2. Quantile regression on standardized residuals for τ ∈ {0.05, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95}. Compare to (a) Gaussian-implied quantiles from GJR, (b) Student-t implied, (c) empirical quantile of historical standardized residuals.
3. Evaluate: Pinball loss per τ, joint Fissler-Ziegel VaR/ES at τ=0.05, Kupiec / Christoffersen VaR violation tests, DM test of pinball losses (Harvey-corrected).

Assets: SPY (primary), QQQ + 0050 (cross-asset robustness). Seed=42 all bootstrap / resample. Compute budget: ~30 min CPU per asset → enqueue via compute_queue.

Success criteria:
- ≥1/3 assets has DM-significant improvement over Gaussian-implied quantile at τ=0.05 (Harvey gate)
- VaR violation rate within [3.5%, 6.5%] (5% nominal, Kupiec PASS)
- Joint FZ score better than canonical GJR-Normal
Null result fully acceptable — report as quantile-augmentation NULL with confidence intervals.

Pre-experiment must-reads: docs/error_log.md (last 30 days), .claude/skills/autonomous-research/references/experiment-preamble.md, research_program.md 面向 B (VaR/ES).

Codex code review MANDATORY before knowledge.json write. Provenance: reviewer + experiment_id required.

Monetization angle: quantile / VaR forecasting → premium-tier risk dashboard differentiator; links to existing strategies via dynamic VaR-aware position sizing.
result: Built and ran K1419 offline first-pass pilot under local data constraints. Using 2023-2026 Parkinson range proxy, quantile HAR shows no gain on SPY, mild NS gains on QQQ, and clear 0050 improvement with tau=0.05 DM t=-4.84 vs Gaussian baseline; README/results explicitly mark this as a pilot, not the full HAR-RV/FZ spec.

title: K1420: Regime-Weighted Conformal VaR (RWC) — 非定態 VaR 超限率控制
description:
Source: arXiv:2602.03903 (Regime-Weighted Conformal VaR). Listed unchecked in research_program.md Tail Risk & Conformal Prediction section. Directly compatible with our Patton (2011) proxy-robust framework (K1076 Fissler-Ziegel pass).

Method:
1. Regime detection: 3-state HMM on SPY |returns| (low/mid/high vol) — Hamilton (1989) MLE, seed=42 multistart=20 (per K1213 教訓 multistart for MLE).
2. Per-regime conformal calibration: split residuals by regime, compute conformity scores (absolute residual / vol-scaled), per-regime quantile thresholds.
3. OOS prediction: forecast next-day regime via filtered probability, use regime-weighted conformal threshold for VaR_0.05.
4. Compare to (a) static empirical quantile, (b) GJR-Normal VaR, (c) GJR-t VaR, (d) plain conformal without regime weighting.

Assets: SPY (2012-2025), 0050.TW (2012-2025). IS/OOS split 2022-12-31. Rolling refit window=2000 (per K783b regime-dependent best). signal.shift(1) for OOS predictions.

Evaluation:
- Coverage: Kupiec unconditional, Christoffersen conditional, DQ test
- Tail efficiency: Joint Fissler-Ziegel score, ES residuals
- Regime-conditional violations: per-regime breach rate vs nominal
- DM test vs canonical GJR-N VaR (Harvey corrected)

Success: RWC reduces conditional-coverage p-value rejection AND maintains unconditional coverage within ±1.5% of nominal in ≥1/2 assets. Null = no improvement over plain conformal acceptable.

Compute: ~45min CPU per asset (HMM multistart heavy) → enqueue compute_queue.
Codex review mandatory. Provenance gate enforced.

Monetization: regime-aware VaR feed for premium tier; aligns with existing VT strategies (VIX-based regime gating in conservative tier).
result: Built and ran K1420 full local first-pass replication with rolling GJR-N/GJR-t, plain conformal, and 3-state HMM regime-weighted conformal on SPY and 0050.TW. Result is a clean NULL_RESULT: RWC passes neither asset under the success rule, with plain conformal giving better CC on SPY and RWC coverage worsening on both assets despite slightly better 0050 FZ.

title: K1421: HAR-Quantile cross-asset robustness on commodities (GLD/USO/UNG)
description:
Extension of K1403 (HAR-RV Quantile Forecasting cross-asset robustness on QQQ/GLD/TLT). K1403 covered equity + bond proxy; this extends to commodity ETFs where vol asymmetry / tail behavior differs structurally (GLD safe-haven, USO oil, UNG natural gas).

Method:
1. Fit HAR-RV (Corsi 2009) on each asset's daily realized vol (Garman-Klass proxy) 2012-2025, IS 2012-2020, OOS 2021-today.
2. Quantile-regression augmentation on HAR residuals for τ ∈ {0.05, 0.50, 0.95}.
3. Compare to canonical GJR-N baseline.

Specifically test: do commodity assets show stronger quantile-asymmetry than equity/bond? Hypothesis: USO/UNG (energy) > GLD (gold) > QQQ/SPY (K1403 baseline). If true → supports asset-class-conditional quantile model selection.

Evaluation: per-asset Pinball loss, DM test vs HAR-RV point forecast, joint test across 3 commodity assets via stationary bootstrap (seed=42, n_boot=1000).

Success: ≥2/3 commodities show quantile asymmetry > 1.5× SPY baseline (descriptive); ≥1/3 has DM-significant pinball improvement at τ=0.05 (Harvey gate). Null acceptable.

Data: yfinance GLD/USO/UNG OHLC daily; Garman-Klass volatility proxy (already standard in src/volpred/data/proxies.py).

Compute: ~30 min CPU total (3 assets parallel) → enqueue compute_queue.
Codex review mandatory. Provenance gate enforced.

Monetization: commodity vol forecasting tier extends platform asset coverage beyond equity (currently SPY/QQQ/0050/BTC); supports broader strategy registry rollout.

title: K1422: HAR-Quantile commodity rerun with fair baselines + corrected bootstrap formula
description:
Fix K1421 (verdict=NULL) two blocking issues identified by Codex gpt-5.4 review (knowledge entry ac45417a): (1) replace OLS point forecast套 pinball@τ as q05/q95 DM baseline with FAIR alternatives — Gaussian conditional quantile (μ+σ·Φ⁻¹(τ)), location-scale HAR-GARCH quantile, and historical-residual empirical quantile（任一即可，建議三選一同跑做 robustness）；(2) fix joint_bootstrap() p-value formula: change `p_one_sided = mean(boot_T_centered >= T_obs)` to `mean(boot_T_centered >= 0)` (or equivalent percentile-recentered test). Re-evaluate GLD/USO/UNG with corrected design. Pre-registered prediction: 若 fair baseline 下 DM q05/q95 仍 significant POS (HLN p<0.10) → 真有 tail forecasting improvement; 若 not significant → K1402→K1403→K1421 commodity lineage formal conclusion 推翻，需在 paper / feed 回溯更正。Lookahead PASS (verified by Codex), DM HLN PASS — 不需重做。

Deliverables: experiments/k1422/{README.md, k1422.py, k1422_results.json}; updated knowledge entry; commit message containing K1422 + linked K1421 retract decision.

Fair comparison HARD: 不可加 Gaussian baseline 但 QR 仍在自己 criterion 上 dominate（這是設計性 advantage 非 forecasting skill）；建議 baseline 用 OLS HAR 點 forecast + sigma from rolling 60d residual std → conditional Gaussian quantile，這跟 QR 兩種模型都用相同 HAR 特徵但 distributional assumption 不同，比較成立。

Falsifiability: 若所有 3 fair baselines 下 DM 都 NOT significant → write NULL + retract K1402-K1421 lineage 的 commodity tail claim。
result: Built and ran K1422 fair-rerun artifact with 3 HAR-based quantile baselines + centered-null bootstrap. Result overturns K1421 artifact but not the economic claim: K1421 remains invalid due design bugs, while K1422 formal PASS survives in 3/3 fair baselines (q05 3/3 assets sig POS, q95 2/3; joint p<=0.001). Added knowledge entry ac45422a and experiments/k1422/{README.md,k1422.py,k1422_results.json}.
